## What's New in 0.1.6

### UI Performance
- Replaced scoreboard `data-for` DOM rebuilds with an in-place DOM row pool and delegated click listeners.
- Flattened nested flexbox layout inside `.sb-card` to block/inline-block and throttled background scoreboard/mouse/console UI updates, eliminating 30–113 ms scoreboard FPS drops on 32-player servers.

### Visual & Gameplay Fixes
- Restored overhead `sprites/voiceicon.spr` speaker icons above talking players (respecting local/server mutes, `scripts/voicemodel.txt` height, third-person, and in-eye observer mode).
- Fixed `MOVETYPE_FOLLOW` sprite rendering in the GL3 renderer so attached sprites (such as full-flash indicators on semiclipped players) stay visible, keep their own angles/opacity, and follow live parent origin; fixed `kRenderTransTexture` sprite depth mask.
